tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.market: Rays -148 / Guardians +136 (Pinnacle); total 6.5 (Over -114); run line Rays -1.5 (+148)
games.matchup: Cleveland Guardians @ Tampa Bay Rays — ALCS Game 6, Rays lead 3-2
games.our_fair: Tampa Bay 58.7% / Cleveland 41.3% (devigged Pinnacle); total Over-6.5 fair 51.9%
games.take: Elimination night in the dome. Freddy Peralta has been the Rays' October ace — 6-0 with a 0.79 ERA over his last 9 appearances and 6 2/3 scoreless innings in this series — while Cleveland is running a bullpen game with Gavin Williams ruled out on short rest and six pitchers already used in Game 5. The market has Tampa at -148, which matches our number almost exactly: implied 59.7% against a fair 58.7%, so there's no true edge to bet. But the lean is the Rays — better starting pitcher, home field (58-27 at the Trop this year), and Cleveland has never won an ALCS when trailing 3-2.

games.matchup: Washington Commanders (1-3-1) @ San Francisco 49ers (5-0) — Week 6 MNF
games.our_fair: San Francisco 79.5% / Washington 20.5% (devigged Pinnacle); spread cover fair: SF 49.0% / WAS 51.0%; total Over-52 fair 49.0%
games.take: The 5-0 Niners own the NFL's best point differential (+61), scoring 30.8 a game against a Washington defense that's allowed 27+ in four of five. Jayden Daniels is expected to start after a full week of practice, but he's missing his starting RB and the line has steamed from -5.5 to -7.5 all week — the market has already priced in the gap. Our number says the spread is a coin flip (49/51), so no true edge at -7.5. The lean is San Francisco on talent — but know you're paying the worst of the number after the two-point steam, and the wind (12 mph, gusts to 20) is a mild flag for the deep passing game and kicking.
